_comment_location: Copy this to bug-report-config.json in a credentials directory OUTSIDE the repo (default ~/.dmhub), NOT next to the scripts. See CREDENTIALS.md. The whole file is OPTIONAL now -- without it the skill still reads reports and closes tickets; only the Discord steps need it.
_comment_keyPath: LEGACY, and not needed by the bug-fix skill: it reaches the bug system through the dashboard API, which holds the service account server-side. Only the older dmhub-admin tooling that shares bugreport_lib.py uses these two. A relative keyPath resolves against this file's own directory.
_comment_discordWebhook: Default channel (#user-feedback): anything not listed in 'channels' posts here.
_comment_channels: Per-type overrides. A webhook is bound to one channel, so routing bugs elsewhere needs that channel's own webhook; 'tag' is a forum tag id IN THAT CHANNEL (optional -- omit for a single-purpose forum).
_comment_tags: Forum tag ids in the DEFAULT channel, per type (see bug-report-list-tags.py).
_comment_discordBotToken: Only used to ARCHIVE a thread on closeout -- webhook tokens cannot touch /channels. Needs a bot in the guild with Manage Threads on both forums. Override with $DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN. Leave empty to skip archiving.
_comment_dmhubRepo: Path to the dmhub checkout. Lets the closeout read TICKETS_PASSWORD out of internal-dashboards/wrangler.jsonc instead of duplicating it here. Not needed when the scripts run from inside that repo.
_comment_ticketsPassword: Only set this if wrangler.jsonc is unreachable. $BUG_TICKETS_PASSWORD overrides it.
